Status: Registered (active). This is a previously unknown sibling entity to Barkmere Group Ltd (BVI). Same naming convention, both incorporated late 2014. Has 2 directorship relationships per Aleph but director identities are privacy-filtered. The Cyprus entity may serve as the European operational arm of the Benedetti corporate network while the BVI entity served as the payment vehicle.

Officers: Alessandro Benedetti (shareholder, Italy, address Via delle Serre 9/A, Florence 50100), Liane Maria Ledwon (shareholder/director/legal representative, Italy/Germany), Cedric Mifsud (secretary, Malta). Liane Maria Ledwon is co-shareholder, director, judicial representative, and legal representative of Tree of Life Limited (Malta). ICIJ lists her linked countries as Italy and Germany. She holds more operational roles than Benedetti (who is only shareholder), suggesting she may be Benedetti's partner/associate who manages day-to-day corporate affairs. The Ledwon surname is German (12 hits in Aleph German Companies Registry), but no Liane Maria Ledwon found in any database -- she has no other visible corporate footprint.

Cedric Mifsud, secretary of Tree of Life Limited (Malta), is Dr. Cedric Mifsud of Mifsud and Mifsud Advocates (123 Melita Street, Valletta VLT 1123, Malta -- same address as Tree of Life). He co-founded the firm in 2007 with his brother Malcolm. Mifsud is also a director of Aegis Corporate Services Limited, a Malta Financial Services Authority-licensed corporate administration firm at the same address. Aegis provides company formation, fiduciary services, ships and yachts registration, aircraft registration, and financial services to European, North American, North African, and Middle Eastern clients.

The Nissan 'coup' against Ghosn was orchestrated by SVP Hari Nada, who struck an immunity deal with Tokyo prosecutors. The internal investigation was led by general counsel Ravinder Passi, who later reported retaliation including demotions and corporate surveillance of his family after questioning the probe's integrity. When the investigation turned toward Nada himself, CEO Nagai shut it down (Aug 2019). The conspiracy theory — supported by Bloomberg's reporting and Ghosn's own claims — holds that Nada and other Nissan executives feared Ghosn's push to deepen the Renault-Nissan integration/merger, which would have diminished Japanese control of Nissan.
